Wins split by class

Label: Wins by three or more
Notes: Won by three goals or more

Label: Clean sheets
Notes: Finished a match without conceding

Label: Goals with a Fire Brew
Notes: Feeds the Brewery unlock in Progression.csv. The match reports `brew` on every goal, so this needs no code.

Label: Matches played
Notes: Feeds the Pub unlock. Every match, league or otherwise.

Label: Keepers broken
Notes: EVERY TIME YOU EMPTY AN OPPOSING KEEPER'S STAMINA. Reported by the match the moment their bar reaches zero - which is also the moment the next shot becomes a certainty, so it is worth counting

Label: Brews poured
Notes: Every brew poured on a player at the Pub. brew_drunk is the event BrewDB already reports - no new event was needed, which is the right answer whenever one already exists

Label: Fouls given away
Notes: EVERY FOUL YOUR SIDE CONCEDES. The foul chance is set by how many triggers you fired in the round, so this number is really a measure of how hard you played

Label: Yellow cards
Notes: Bookings against your side

Label: Red cards
Notes: Sendings-off against your side. Each one costs you a man for the rest of the match and leaves a hole in a tier that a survivor has to cover

ONE COUNTER PER CLASS. duels_won_as_Lorelei, duels_won_as_Rauhnacht-Feuergeister, and so on - the game makes them as it meets them. Written for the emblems: the Belphegor emblem turns over at count:duels_won_as_Rauhnacht-Feuergeister>=4, which is your card text made testable.

Label: Lorelei Tier I traded
Notes: GREMORY'S CONDITION. Wired in round Z: every Rose Unit token that replaces a Lorelei Tier I unit. Event token_made has the facts kind, class, tier, card (the card it REPLACED) and by.

Label: Lorelei turned into Swans
Notes: ZEPAR'S CONDITION. Wired in round Z: every Lorelei turned into a Swan (Zepar's Emblem does it on reveal).

Label: Enemies marked with Song
Notes: SALLOS'S CONDITION. Wired in round Z: every Song counter a Lorelei puts on an enemy. Event counter_placed has kind, class (who placed it), on, on_class.

Label: Rauhnacht fusions
Notes: FLAUROS'S CONDITION ('four Rauhnacht-Feuergeister units have fused'). Wired in round AD (C6): every fusion with a bench card. Event fused has the facts class, tier, card and with (the bench card).

Label: Rauhnacht units fielded
Notes: BUER'S CONDITION, wired in round AA: 'Eight Rauhnacht-Feuergeister have been active at some point' = eight DIFFERENT Rauhnacht cards have played a duel this match. card_played has the facts class, tier, card and first (yes the first time that card plays).

Label: Mines worked
Notes: BELIAL'S CONDITION ('four Bergmännlein have collected Ore Counters during a PLAY MAKER'). Wired in round AD (C6): once per PLAY MAKER at which your mines were worked, and once per Tobias 'choose 1 mine'. Event mine_worked has amount (how many mines).

Label: Tier IV Bergmännlein ore
Notes: HAURES'S CONDITION, wired in round AA: 'If your Tier IV Bergmännlein have collected 4 Ore Counters' = every time a Tier IV Bergmännlein gains Ore. (It was bergmann_goalie_saves on the 'every duel won' placeholder - which turned Haures over in a test match by accident.)

Label: Unkengeister in exhaust
Notes: VASSAGO'S CONDITION ('4 Unkengeister in the exhaust zone at once'). Wired in round AE (C7): the most Unkengeister ever in your exhaust at once - event exhaust_peak reports each new high (amount = how much it went up).

Label: Cold touches
Notes: GLASYA-LABOLAS'S CONDITION ('four Unkengeister have used cold touch'). Wired in round AD (C6): every cold touch an Unkengeister card puts on the ball.

Label: Gravestones raised
Notes: CAIM'S CONDITION ('four Unkengeister have summoned gravestones'). Wired in round AD (C6): every gravestone an Unkengeister card summons.

Label: Players turned
Notes: ROUND X. A plain player who had his third beer and became a class. Fired once, when you choose which card he becomes.
One counter per class: players_turned_lorelei and so on. Good for an achievement - turn five into Lorelei.

Label: Players recruited
Notes: ROUND X. Every recruit:I0 that signed somebody. Counted even while named_recruits is off, because the save remembers him either way.

Label: Belphegor victory counters
Notes: BELPHEGOR'S CONDITION (round Z - it was count:duels_won_as_Rauhnacht-Feuergeister, which ignored the 'only two per cycle'). Every victory counter a Rauhnacht-Feuergeister puts on the Emblem.

Label: Bergmännlein ore collections
Notes: VALEFOR'S CONDITION (round Z, was bergmann_ore_spent - your text says COLLECTED). One per time a Bergmännlein gains Ore, however much.

Label: Ore collected
Notes: ROUND Z. All the Ore your side gained.

Label: Ore spent
Notes: ROUND Z. All the Ore your side paid for abilities.

Label: Tokens made
Notes: ROUND Z. Rose / Swan Unit tokens.

Label: Swans made
Notes: ROUND Z.

Label: Counters placed
Notes: ROUND Z. One counter per kind: counters_placed_burn, counters_placed_song...
